## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0, electron n = +3.2×10¹² and hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Both complete (not interrupted), no leakage (≤ 0.2 nA), T 1.17–1.29 K, `sr1` peak ≤ 12 % of the 50 µV full scale (no clipping). Raw first, then background-subtracted, then per-tone onsets (`sdh_onset`) and windowed FFTs against F_L and the ABAB model (scale 1).

**Electron, run 6 (F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB model 7.3 / 25.8 T, ABCA 33.1 T).** Strong SdH above ~1.3 T that goes into the QH regime above ~5 T. Rxx minima reach 0 and slightly negative, so the B_1–B_2 pair has a small Hall admixture. Tones: **≈ 7.2 T** (SNR 100–120; still above threshold at the 1.0 T edge of the 10 mT-sampled record, so **its onset is below 1 T**. Run 6 is 50 mT-sampled below 1 T, which is blind to F ≳ 7 T there.) Also **≈ 22.3 T** (onset 1.4 T), **≈ 29.4 T** (onset 1.8 T), ≈ 14.8 T, and high-field-only combs at 39–118 T (onset ≥ 2.6 T; QH harmonics). `sdh_onset`'s ratio screen flags 14.8 / 22.3 / 29.4 as 2× / 3× / 4× of 7.2. The investigation forbids settling that on the ratio alone. 7.2 + 22.3 = 29.5 ≈ the 29.4 tone, so the same set reads as an ABAB pair at density scale ≈ 0.87–0.9 (model 7.3 / 25.8 → 6.4–6.6 / 22.4–23.2) plus a sum/breakdown tone at the F_L position. It also reads as a 7.2 T harmonic comb, or as an ABCA singleton at scale 0.89 with extras. **One density cannot separate these. The n-dependence can:** a harmonic tracks k·f₁(n), a real pocket tracks its own Onsager curve, and a sum tone tracks f₁ + f₂. That is the fan's job.

**Hole, run 7 (F_L = 12.4 T; ABAB model ≈ 6.0 / 6.6 T, ABCA 12.4 T at m* ≈ 1.1).** This side is cleaner: onset 0.7 T. Tones ≈ 6.6 T (dominant), ≈ 4.7 T, ≈ 12.3 T (strongest above 3 T), and ≈ 8.5 T. These sit in the investigation's **near-CNP hole exception regime**: on the D = 0 line the hole side is TG-limited at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹². There the ABAB pair is close and balanced, and the 12.3 T tone could be F_L, 2 × 6.6 or a sum tone. **Not decisive.**

**Take:** the hole side is cleaner at its one density, but only the **electron side** reaches the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² band where the templates separate, and it carries SNR 50–120 tones there. The fan goes on the electron side. Onset inputs: the light tone is below 1 T (censored at the record edge), the heavy tones are at 1.4–1.8 T. The sensitivity (50 µV) and settling (10 τ) are inherited.

"""sdh-spot-check read, runs 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n = -1.2e12), D = 0 (run-5 cal).
Raw MR first, then background-subtracted vs 1/B, sdh_onset per tone, windowed FFTs vs F_L and the ABAB model."""
import sys, warnings
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError, resolve_channels
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env" / "hera" / "models" / "tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as FSM

spots = {6: dict(n=+3.2, wins=[(1.0, 10.0), (1.5, 10.0), (2.0, 10.0)]),
         7: dict(n=-1.2, wins=[(0.7, 10.0), (1.0, 10.0), (1.5, 10.0)])}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for j, (rid, sp) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I); o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]
    sens = 50e-6; FL = float(luttinger_frequency(sp["n"] * 1e16))
    ab = FSM.abab_mstar(sp["n"] * 1e16); Fa, ma = FSM.abca_mstar(sp["n"] * 1e16)
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {sp['n']:+.1f}e12, D = 0 | F_L = {FL:.1f} T | model ABAB " + ", ".join(f"{F:.1f} T (m* {m:.3f})" for F, m in ab)
          + f" | ABCA {Fa:.1f} T (m* {ma:.3f})")
    print(f"    B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, {len(B)} pts; R {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm; I {np.median(I)*1e9:.2f} nA; "
          f"peak |sr1_X|/FS = {np.abs(r.col('sr1_X')).max()/sens:.2f}; T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K; "
          f"max |I_tg|, |I_bg| = {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f}, {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} RAW, n = {sp['n']:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    # onset on the adequately sampled record (run 6 is 50 mT-sampled below 1 T: Nyquist-blind to F > ~7 T there)
    blo = 1.0 if rid == 6 else 0.3
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        try:
            on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=blo, r_full_scale=sens / np.median(I)); print(on.summary())
        except SdhOnsetError as e:
            on = None; print("SdhOnsetError:", e)
    for x in w: print("    note:", str(x.message)[:160])
    m = B > 0.7
    cf = np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 7)
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], R[m] - np.polyval(cf, B[m]), lw=0.6)
    ax[1, j].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="dR (Ohm), deg-7 bg in B", title=f"run {rid} background-subtracted (B > 0.7 T)")
    for lo, hi in sp["wins"]:
        f, S = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5, log=False, nfft=1 << 14)
        s = S[0]; pk = [k for k in range(1, len(f) - 1) if s[k] > s[k - 1] and s[k] > s[k + 1] and f[k] > 1.5]
        pk = sorted(sorted(pk, key=lambda k: -s[k])[:6])
        print(f"    FFT {lo}-{hi} T (dF = {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.2f} T): " + ", ".join(f"{f[k]:.1f}({s[k]/max(s[pk]):.2f})" for k in pk))
        ax[2, j].plot(f, s / s[f > 1.5].max(), lw=0.9, label=f"{lo}-{hi} T")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L {FL:.1f} T")
    for F, _ in ab: ax[2, j].axvline(F, color="b", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[2, j].set(xlim=(0, 2.2 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm.)", title=f"run {rid} FFT (blue dotted: ABAB model, scale 1)")
    ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`), n 1.4 → 3.2×10¹², B 0.8 → 5 T uniform in 1/B

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n 1.4-3.2e12 (61, paired Vtg/Vbg), B 0.8->5.0 T uniform-1/B (106 rows, d(1/B)=0.0100), fast\_delay 2.1 s (7tau), sr1 50 uV; ends 5 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~10:36** (≈5h10m)

**Why this fan.** Runs 6/7 (ana, spot checks): the electron spot at n = +3.2×10¹² shows tones at ≈ 7.2 / 22.3 / 29.4 T (F_L = 33.1 T). One density reads this three ways: an ABAB pair at density scale ≈ 0.88 plus a sum/breakdown tone at the F_L position, a 7.2 T harmonic comb, or an ABCA singleton plus extras. Only the **n-dependence** separates them (investigation Step 4/5): a pocket follows its own Onsager curve, a harmonic follows k·f₁(n), and a sum tone follows f₁ + f₂ = F_L(n). The hole side is cleaner (onset 0.7 T) but is TG-limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² on D = 0. That is the near-CNP exception regime, where the ABAB pair (≈ 6.0 / 6.6 T) cannot be resolved. So the fan goes on the electron side, where the templates separate: at 2.5×10¹² the ABAB heavy tone is 20.7 T against F_L 25.8 T.

**Design (floored, per `landau-fan` step 1).**
- **B_hi = 5 T.** Above ~4–5 T, QH harmonics (58 / 88 / 117 T, onsets 3.8–6 T in run 6) would fold into the claim band at this Δ(1/B). The record above the heavy-tone onset (1.4 T) still gives δF = 1.9 T, so heavy vs F_L is split by ≥ 2 δF for n ≳ 2.1×10¹².
- **B_lo = 0.8 T.** The light (partner-candidate) tone is still above threshold at the 1.0 T edge of run 6's finely sampled record, so its onset is below 1 T, and its expected onset scales with m* to ≈ 0.6 T. 0.8 T gives the ABAB partner ≥ 5 periods across n ≈ 2.5–3.2×10¹² and ≈ 4 at 2.2×10¹².
- **B grid:** Δ(1/B) = 0.0100 T⁻¹, which is 3.0 samples per period at F_L(3.2×10¹²) and 2.75 if the scale is +10 %. That gives **N_B = 106**.
- **n axis:** Δn = 0.030×10¹², which is 2.6 points per LL at 0.8 T and 3.2 at 1 T. That gives **N_n = 61**.
- **Dwell:** 2.1 s = 7 τ (0.3 s, 24 dB). This is the settle floor, and it keeps the lock-in smear along n at ≤ 0.1 LL period at B_lo. The n-sweep runs in one direction every row, so the residual lag is a uniform ~0.6-point n offset (≤ 1 % in F).
- **Sensitivity:** 50 µV (5 kΩ FS), fixed, inherited from runs 6/7. The worst corner is n = 1.4×10¹² × 5 T: 90 Ω at 0 T × ≤ 6× MR comes to ~10 % FS.
- **Price:** 106 rows × (61 × 2.23 s + ~6.5 s) = 4.2 h, plus the in-fan ramp (31 min) and positioning (0 → 0.8 T, 6 min). About 4.8 h floor, quoted at +7 %. Ends at **5 T** with the gates parked at 0. The field stays there on purpose, because the next step (LK mass split, or a hole-side read) rides it down.

**Coverage trade.** Excluded: the hole side (not resolvable inside the validators, above), and electron n < 1.4×10¹². That is the ABAB low-density mimic regime (heavy tone → 0.95 F_L), where the partner can't be resolved at any practical B_lo; extending to 1.0×10¹² would add ~25 % (≈ 1.2 h). Two things to watch for in the per-column FFTs. Region B (run 5, electron-doped by 0.43×10¹²) is a series-mosaic confound: it would add a parallel tone family at F_L(n + 0.43). There is also a small Hall admixture in B_1–B_2 (Rxx < 0 at QH minima in run 6). Only one Rxx pair exists, so the call is single-region.

**Guards / checkpoints.** Preconditions: T at base, B ≈ 0, heaters off, Si 0, lock-in τ / slope / drive read-checked. In-run trips on |I_gate| > 1 nA or T > 1.8 K; `sr1` rail events are printed. Checkpoint 1 is the first 3 rows (~8 min in): signal level vs FS, 10 nA drain, leakage, paired gate columns, B tracking. Checkpoint 2 is ~1.2 h (row 25, B ≈ 1.0 T): the n = 3.2 column against run 6. Checkpoint 3 is ~2.5 h (row 58, B ≈ 1.5 T): partial per-column FFT, where the partner tone should appear across n ≈ 2.5–3.2; abandon if it doesn't. Checkpoint 4 is ~3.7 h (row 85, B ≈ 2.5 T): heavy tones, and rail check at low n.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, for tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4) ===
# n 1.4 -> 3.2e12 (61 pts, fast, paired Vtg/Vbg), B 0.8 -> 5.0 T uniform in 1/B (106 rows, slow, ascending)
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_LO, N_HI, N_N, D0 = 1.4, 3.2, 61, 0.0          # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 0.8, 5.0, 106                    # T; d(1/B) = 0.0100 1/T = 1/(3 F_L(3.2e12))
ns = np.linspace(N_LO, N_HI, N_N); Ds = D0 * np.ones(N_N)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs, Vbgs)
B_vec = field_invB(B_LO, B_HI, N_B)
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
dinv = 1 / B_vec[0] - 1 / B_vec[1]
print(f"fast: n {ns[0]:+.2f}..{ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({N_N} pts, dn {ns[1]-ns[0]:.3f}e12), D = {D0}; Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {N_B} rows uniform 1/B, d(1/B) = {dinv:.5f} 1/T (Nyquist {1/(2*dinv):.1f} T; F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T)")
# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {T_vaporizer():.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan pre-positions 0 -> {B_LO} T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "a heater is on — fan assumes base T"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
_amp, _frq, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"lock-in: drive {_amp} V @ {_frq} Hz (1.0 V / 13.777 Hz -> 10 nA), sr1 tau {_tau} s / {_slope} dB (0.3 s / 24 dB, operator-set — read only), sr0 tau {sr0.time_constant()} s")
assert abs(_amp - 1.0) < 1e-3 and abs(_frq - 13.777) < 1e-3 and _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (inherited from runs 6/7): 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA.
# Worst corner n = 1.4e12 x 5 T: R(0 T) = 90 Ohm (run 5) x QH-regime MR (runs 6/7: <= 4-6x) ~ 0.5 kOhm -> ~10 % FS.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
SENS = sr1.sensitivity()
print(f"sr1 sens {SENS} V (5 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 2.0     # 7 tau at 24 dB (settle floor); slow_delay after each field step (driver adds 3 s settle)
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 1.8
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n {N_LO}..{N_HI}e12 ({N_N}), B {B_LO}->{B_HI} T uniform-1/B ({N_B}), "
                  f"sr1 50 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s; cal run 5; for tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = {N_LO} to {N_HI}e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts, paired Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} / Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}), '
              f'B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T uniform in 1/B ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) {dinv:.4f}); per-column SdH-FFT fan, electron side; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'investigation tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4; inputs sdh-spot-check runs 6/7')
# --- position: gates to the first n point, field 0 -> B_LO (blocking, ~6 min) ---
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)
_rail = {"n": 0}
def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, T = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
